SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Main physical features in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Main physical features in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Main physical features in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Main physical features in Eastern Africa.

3. Which statement about Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa.
   B. Treat Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Historic Built Environments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Historic Built Environments as rumours only.
   D. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Culture and Social Organisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Culture and Social Organisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Culture and Social Organisation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Culture and Social Organisation.
   D. Explain Culture and Social Organisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Vegetation in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Vegetation in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Eastern Africa.

7. Which statement about Beef Farming is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Beef Farming with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Beef Farming never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Beef Farming.
   D. Treat Beef Farming as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Language groups in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Language groups in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Language groups in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Language groups in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Language groups in Eastern Africa.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Replace the compass rose

10. Which statement about Population distribution in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population distribution in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population distribution in Eastern Africa.
   D. Treat Population distribution in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Hide all money underground

12. Which statement about School and Community is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain School and Community with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say School and Community never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat School and Community as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing School and Community.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Historic Built Environments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Language groups in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Population distribution in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Culture and Social Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
